description: Implementation of a Twilio voice call provider with media streaming, TTS, webhook handling, and call control functions.

classes.name: TwilioProvider
classes.description: A class implementing the VoiceCallProvider interface for Twilio, supporting call initiation, hangup, media streaming, TTS, and webhook verification.

methods.name: createTwilioRequestDedupeKey
methods.description: Creates a deduplication key for Twilio webhook requests based on headers and body.

methods.name: setPublicUrl
methods.description: Sets the public URL used for webhook signature verification and media streaming.

methods.name: getPublicUrl
methods.description: Returns the current public URL used for webhook verification.

methods.name: setTTSProvider
methods.description: Assigns a TelephonyTtsProvider for TTS streaming.

methods.name: setMediaStreamHandler
methods.description: Assigns a MediaStreamHandler for media streaming.

methods.name: registerCallStream
methods.description: Associates a call SID with a media stream SID.

methods.name: hasRegisteredStream
methods.description: Checks if a call SID has a registered media stream.

methods.name: unregisterCallStream
methods.description: Removes a call's media stream registration.

methods.name: isConversationStreamConnectEnabled
methods.description: Determines if media stream connection is enabled based on handler and URL.

methods.name: isValidStreamToken
methods.description: Validates a stream token for a call SID.

methods.name: clearTtsQueue
methods.description: Clears the TTS queue for a call to allow barge-in.

methods.name: apiRequest
methods.description: Performs an authenticated request to Twilio API.

methods.name: verifyWebhook
methods.description: Verifies the webhook signature for incoming requests.

methods.name: parseWebhookEvent
methods.description: Parses and normalizes a Twilio webhook event into internal format.

methods.name: parseDirection
methods.description: Converts Twilio direction string to normalized format.

methods.name: normalizeEvent
methods.description: Converts webhook parameters into a normalized call event.

methods.name: generateTwimlResponse
methods.description: Generates TwiML response XML based on call state and configuration.

methods.name: getStreamUrl
methods.description: Constructs WebSocket URL for media streaming based on public URL and stream path.

methods.name: getStreamAuthToken
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an authentication token for media stream.

methods.name: getStreamUrlForCall
methods.description: Constructs a media stream URL with token for a specific call.

methods.name: getStreamConnectXml
methods.description: Creates TwiML to connect a call to a WebSocket media stream.

methods.name: initiateCall
methods.description: Starts an outbound call via Twilio API, optionally storing TwiML for notify mode.

methods.name: hangupCall
methods.description: Hangs up a call and cleans up related state.

methods.name: playTts
methods.description: Plays TTS audio via media stream or fallback TwiML <Say>.

methods.name: playTtsViaStream
methods.description: Streams synthesized TTS audio over WebSocket, handling chunking and timing.

methods.name: startListening
methods.description: Starts speech recognition via Twilio <Gather>.

methods.name: stopListening
methods.description: Stops speech recognition (no-op for Twilio).

methods.name: getCallStatus
methods.description: Retrieves call status from Twilio API and normalizes it.
